_notes: Hades slice prop layout (data layer replacement for BuildSliceProps.AddProps and BuildSliceSmoke.AddBoulders). Coordinates are Unity world metres, y up, z toward the gate. pos y = constants[yBase] + pos[1] (yBase 'world' = 0). ground 'bottom': LOD0 bounds bottom sits on pos y (PlaceLod behaviour). ground 'boundsCentreSink': LOD0 bounds centre goes on pos xz, then the bottom is sunk to waterY - sinkFraction * height (old AddBoulders). Seeded jitter (boulders seed 31, trees seed 77) is baked as numbers; edit the numbers freely. Entries with tag 'new' come from UNITY_MISSING_PROPS.md and are disabled until approved. disabled=true skips an entry. baseColorMul tints base colour (old broken_oar hack). Entries tagged 'hero' (r4) use GLBs from hades_env/processed/hero_props/<name>/ that must be copied to Assets/Env/Props/<name>/; they do not need a Prop-schema change (no alignToGround support in the loader: positions are not terrain-snapped); 'rationale' is a free text field ignored by the loader (JsonUtility skips unknown fields). hero_heavy LOD profile = aggressive switching for >50k tri props. asset file = libraries[library].pattern with {asset} and {lod}. | v2 (world build): WorldNear/WorldMid/WorldFar groups from scripts/world_layout_gen.py; pos y already snapped to terrain_midground (ground bottom). lodProfiles.name: sky_ridge
lodProfiles._about: LOD0/LOD1 can never be selected (screen height cannot exceed 1 for a ridge in view at 10x), so every ridge is the 2.5-3.2k tri LOD2 and is never culled by size

lodProfiles.name: sky_ruin
lodProfiles._about: far_ruin LOD1 (2.6-3.3k tris) while a tower fills > 30 % of the screen height, else LOD2 (0.75-1.2k tris); LOD0 (20 MB glb) only if one fills the whole screen

Right mid-flank beside the lock camera view edge; inner edge ~5.9 m from the axis, off the causeway and the fight lane. Unity-space suggestion, NOT checked against terrain.

Stake barricade at the right edge of the platform front (inner face of the side wall at x 9.75), keeps the centre open. Unity-space suggestion, NOT checked against terrain.
Fallen shield left of the stair head, near column_b; heavy mesh (95k) so the hero_heavy LOD profile. Unity-space suggestion, NOT checked against terrain.
Planted banner pole (3 m, cairn base) right of the doorway, in front of the gate face (z 27); heavy mesh (54k) so hero_heavy LOD. Unity-space suggestion, NOT checked against terrain.
